description: Returns a list of playlists matching the supplied filters. The 'zip' field contains a URL to download the playlist's tracks as a high‑quality MP3 zip, but the zip may contain fewer tracks than the playlist (internal limit of about 100 tracks). Requires a client_id; an access_token can be supplied for user‑specific data.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wraps the JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with json format and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 10, max 200; 'all' still caps at 200.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by field(s). Append _asc or _desc for direction; ascending is default.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, adds 'results_fullcount' header with total rows ignoring limit/offset (performance impact).

parameters.name: namesearch
parameters.description: Search playlist by name using wildcard matching.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: One or more author IDs (no access token required).

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: OAuth2 access token for the Jamendo user.

parameters.name: datebetween
parameters.description: Created between dates. Format: from_to (both integers).

parameters.name: audioformat
parameters.description: Audio format for file URLs; currently only mp32 (mp3 192kbps).

notes: The 'zip' field in the response may contain fewer tracks than the playlist due to a server‑side limit of ~100 tracks.
If both 'client_id' and 'access_token' are supplied, the access token is used for user‑specific data while client_id satisfies the required API key.
